title: Fixed Point
summary: For an array of unique integers sorted in ascending order, identify the least index where the value equals the index.
statement: For an array of unique integers sorted in ascending order, identify the least index where the value equals the index. If no such index exists, return -1.
constraints: Return the smallest index i with arr[i]==i, or -1.
hints: For a strictly increasing array, arr[i]-i is nondecreasing.
Binary-search the first position where arr[i]>=i while recording equality.
Move left on equality to find the smallest fixed point.
Monotonicity rules out the discarded half at every comparison.
editorial: Monotonicity rules out the discarded half at every comparison.

tests.explanation: Index three stores value three and is the first fixed point.
Index zero is immediately a fixed point.
